lines.text: When God arises, His enemies scatter like smoke, and the righteous rejoice before Him.
God is a father of the fatherless and a defender of widows, and He settles the lonely in families.
When God marched through the wasteland, the earth shook before the One on Horeb, and He refreshed His weary inheritance.
Mount Hermon is a mountain of God, and His chariots number tens of thousands, and He ascended on high.
Envoys will arrive from Egypt, and Cush will stretch out her hands to God.
